<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

E2E test selection is migrated from shard-based labels (`shard-0`/`shard-1`) to explicit `feature:*` filters. Make targets, the e2e infrastructure script, and all Ginkgo test suites are updated so operator/image setup and availability waits are gated by feature labels (or no label filter) instead of shard membership.

## Changes

**Shard-to-Feature Label Migration**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Make target label filter updates** <br> `Makefile-test.mk`|CI Make targets `test-e2e-extended-shard-0`, `test-e2e-extended-shard-1`, `test-tas-e2e-extended-shard-0`, and `test-tas-e2e-extended-shard-1` now use explicit feature label filters (`feature:kuberay`, `feature:appwrapper`, etc.) instead of `shard-0`/`shard-1`. Kuberay shard-0 targets add `kind-ray-project-mini-image-build` as a prerequisite.|
|**Test infrastructure script refactoring** <br> `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`|Removed shard constants. Conditional logic for exporting operator manifests, preparing/pulling Docker images, and installing operators in kind now gates on `GINKGO_ARGS` feature matches or the absence of `--label-filter`; KubeRay Ray image selection and optional pull remain via `determine_kuberay_ray_image` and `USE_RAY_FOR_TESTS`.|
|**SingleCluster extended test suite updates** <br> `test/e2e/singlecluster/extended/*`|Ginkgo suites (AppWrapper, JAX, JobSet, KubeRay, LeaderWorkerSet, PyTorchJob, TrainJob) remove `util.Shard0`/`util.Shard1` labels. `BeforeSuite` availability waits now match feature labels directly instead of shard membership.|
|**TAS extended test suite updates** <br> `test/e2e/tas/extended/*`|Ginkgo suites (AppWrapper, JobSet, LeaderWorkerSet, MPIJob, PyTorchJob, RayJob, TrainJob) remove shard labels. `BeforeSuite` replaces shard-grouped waits with independent feature-based guards (including `feature:mpijob`).|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

  **Add training-operator readiness gate to TAS extended suite for PyTorchJob**
  
  `test/e2e/tas/extended/pytorch_test.go` is labeled `feature:pytorchjob` and creates `PyTorchJob` resources using the Kubeflow training-operator types/utilities. `test/e2e/tas/extended/suite_test.go` BeforeSuite currently waits for `kubeflow-trainer-controller-manager` under `feature:trainjob`, but does not wait for the `training-operator` deployment when `feature:pytorchjob` (or `feature:jaxjob`) is enabled.
  
  Add this gate alongside the other operator waits (matching the singlecluster pattern):
  
  ```go
  if ginkgo.Label("feature:jaxjob", "feature:pytorchjob").MatchesLabelFilter(labelFilter) {
  	util.WaitForKubeFlowTrainingOperatorAvailability(ctx, k8sClient)
  }
  ```
